D/ IMP C M AVR PROBVS P F AVG ; R/ ORI[GINI AVG, in ex XXIT

Cast copper alloy radiate of Probus Date: 276-282 Diameter 19mm, weight 2.17g Obverse: Radiate, helmeted and cuirassed bust facing left holding a spear and shield. Obverse inscription: IMP C M AVR PROBVS P F AVG Reverse: Twins suckling from the she wolf Reverse inscription: ORI[GINI AVG, in ex XXIT Condition: fine RIC V, pt 2, 701. This is a rare coin
